integrity: Analytical proof with independent Bernoulli factorization and elementary Dirichlet approximation. Supplementary finite checks are not infinite proof. A bibliographic risk remains concerning possible earlier Riesz-product formulations.
limitations: The probabilities must converge. No arbitrary-bias or general-measure classification is claimed. The topological positional-gap Dirichlet criterion is already known in broader related settings.
title: Strong versus uniform rigidity for independently weighted Cantor multipliers
